title: NFL salary cap will skyrocket next season to record $301.2 million per club

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL salary cap will skyrocket next season to record $301.2 million per club
sources.description: The NFL salary cap is dramatically increasing in 2026, as the league announced on Friday that the cap will be at $301,200,000. That's a jump of around $22 million from 2025.
